header.title: How to Install a Gas Dryer Vent
header.description: This guide provides step-by-step instructions on how to safely install a gas dryer vent, ensuring proper ventilation and preventing potential hazards.

steps.description: Select either a flexible plastic hose or a rigid sheet metal pipe for the vent, and choose appropriate hardware and drilling tools based on the material being drilled.
actions: Choose between a flexible plastic hose and a rigid sheet metal pipe.
Consider the sagging tendency of flexible plastic hoses.
Assess the potential fire hazard of lint accumulation in flexible hoses.
Select hardware and drilling tools based on the material (wood, metal, or brick).
steps.part: Pipe (flexible plastic hose or rigid sheet metal pipe)

steps.description: This step involves selecting and marking a location for the dryer vent, both inside and outside the house, ensuring it's free of obstructions.
actions: Decide where you want your dryer vent to be located.
Check outside to make sure the location isn’t blocked by bushes or fencing.
Measure from the corner of the foundation or a window inside.
Relocate the spot outside using the same marker.

steps.description: Drill a guide hole inside the house for the dryer vent, ensuring to drill through the sill plate in the basement or checking for obstructions on the main floor.
actions: Drill a small guide hole inside the house
Locate the wood sill plate (if in the basement)
Drill through the sill plate (if in the basement)
Ensure there's nothing in the wall when drilling (if on the main floor)

steps.description: Cut a 4-inch hole where the vent will be located, ensuring the previous guide hole is centered.
actions: Cut a larger hole outside
Center the 4-inch hole around the guide hole

steps.description: Attach the vent hood to the side of the house, secure it with screws, and seal around the shroud and pipe to prevent drafts and rodents.
actions: Install the vent hood on the side of the house
Use wood screws to secure the vent hood
Caulk around the shroud
Caulk around the pipe

steps.description: Connect a 90-degree elbow to the vent pipe at both the dryer and existing vent locations, and seal the joints with foil tape.
actions: Go inside the house.
Fasten a 90-degree elbow to the end of the vent pipe using hose clamps.
Run the vent pipe back to the dryer.
Install another elbow at the point where the exhaust comes out of the dryer.
Hook up the vent pipe to that elbow.
Use foil tape to seal the joints connecting the pipe segments.

steps.description: Return the dryer to its original location and ensure it is level, avoiding any kinks in the vent piping.
actions: Move the dryer back into place.
Make adjustments to ensure the dryer is level.
Ensure the vent piping is not kinked.
